name: Subactor Twin Capability Map
summary: Resolves an intent into an ordered connector plan or one named missing precondition.
description: Loads the reviewed Plesk twin directly from Git, retains a validated last-known-good fallback, joins it with live API inventory and held credential handles, then answers whether an intent is executable across one or more connectors. Query effect only: it plans, it never mutates. API observation may enrich resources or downgrade readiness but can never grant an unreviewed route.

baseline.loading: git-primary with exact commit provenance; validated cache then embedded package data are availability-only fallbacks; live API only enriches
